loader_modification.name: Static Embind CSP compatibility patch
loader_modification.description: Only craftInvokerFunction and __emval_get_method_caller are replaced by upstream Emscripten4.0.10 DYNAMIC_EXECUTION=0 synchronous static-closure fallbacks. WASM unchanged. The served loader is derived, not byte-identical to the official npm loader.

loader_modification.reproduce: Extract mujoco.js from exact npm package, then patch -p0 < embind-static-csp.patch
loader_modification.validation: Existing engine tests pass under node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings; strict browser CSP validation is recorded separately.
